plays.summary: A high aerial ball drops into central midfield where white and dark blue contest the second ball before white gains control.

players.note: Controlled a bouncing ball in traffic and recycled possession calmly like Sergio Busquets.
Anticipate the drop of the aerial ball earlier and get body position inside to win the second ball.

plays.summary: White advances down the far left flank and works the ball inside to central midfield.

players.note: Carried the ball up the touchline before cutting a pass inside to midfield like Jack Grealish.
Close the ball carrier down quicker on the touchline to cut off the inside passing lane.

plays.summary: White's central midfielder drives forward and threads a through ball for the striker, whose effort inside the box is forced behind for a corner by dark blue's defender and goalkeeper.

players.note: Threaded a line-breaking pass into space with the vision and weight of Kevin De Bruyne.
Timed the diagonal run behind the back line and attacked the penalty area like Jamie Vardy.
Tracked the striker's run and recovered well to apply pressure like Virgil van Dijk.
Narrowed the angle quickly to help shut down the chance like Alisson Becker.

plays.summary: Play pauses as white sets up to take a corner kick from the far right corner and both teams organize in the penalty area.
White delivers the corner kick into the box, where dark blue clears the aerial danger and begins transitioning out.

players.note: Deliver the corner with more pace toward the six-yard box so attackers can meet it before defenders clear.
Attacked the incoming set piece decisively in the air to clear danger like Giorgio Chiellini.

plays.summary: Dark blue wins possession on the far side and launches a counter-attack as their midfielder dribbles across midfield into white's half.

players.note: Drop and delay the ball carrier earlier instead of allowing a straight dribble through the central channel.
Drove through midfield at pace on the transition like Mateo Kovacic.

plays.summary: Dark blue tries to push forward in the shaded left-wing area before white crowds them out, wins possession, and turns play upfield.

players.note: Stepped in cleanly on the touchline to win the ball and spark the transition like Kyle Walker.
Look to release the ball earlier before getting trapped against the touchline by multiple defenders.

plays.summary: White counter-attacks down the far touchline moving right before their inside pass is cut out in midfield by dark blue.

players.note: Check inside options carefully and play a firmer pass so it is not cut out in midfield.
Read the inside pass and stepped into midfield to cut it out like N'Golo Kante.

plays.summary: Dark blue number 20 wins the ball in midfield, shows composure under pressure, and plays a crisp pass out to the right flank.

players.note: Angle the press to block the wide passing lane rather than letting the midfielder turn comfortably.
Controlled the turnover calmly and switched play cleanly under pressure like Toni Kroos.

plays.summary: White presses dark blue's right-back into a turnover near the touchline and attacks into the penalty box, resulting in a shot dealt with by dark blue for a goal kick.

players.note: Pressed aggressively on the touchline to force the turnover and drive into the box like Bukayo Saka.
Get a cleaner first touch inside the box to set up a decisive finish before defenders close.
Play a simple back pass or clear down the line when pressed tightly near your own corner.
Closed down the danger inside the penalty area to protect the goal like Ruben Dias.

plays.summary: Play stops as the dark blue goalkeeper retrieves the ball and sets up for a goal kick while both teams reset.
